beers.name: Beaglepuss Dry Curious West Coast Pilz
beers.description_excerpt: For those seeking a truly bold non-alcoholic experience, Beaglepuss Dry Curious West Coast Pilz is a must-try. Lean and bone-dry, it elegantly channels traditional pilsner finesse while embracing a modern hop perspective. Expect vibrant bursts of citrus and pine, complemented by a subtle hint of dank resin, all supported by premium pilsner malt that ensures a refreshing and snappy taste.
